standard_prerequisites.name: The condition on a pair (stack, point) given by the quasi-compactness of the fibre above the point of the relation of a smooth presentation
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Referred to in the statement (source lines 10341-10343) and used in the proof (source lines 10356-10358) as a pointer to the chapter on properties of stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the fibre of the second projection over a chosen point a quasi-compact algebraic space.

standard_prerequisites.name: The openness of the map on topological spaces induced by a smooth morphism, and the criterion for a point of a target to be reached by a point of a scheme mapping to it, through the scheme theoretic image
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are used inside the counted proof (source lines 10354-10355 and 10369-10372), the second as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a point of the presentation over the specialising point and then a point above the given specialisation specialising to the chosen point.

core_obligations: Reduce the presentation: the proof replaces the algebraic space by an affine scheme etale over it at the chosen point, so that the presentation may be assumed affine (proof lines 10349-10351)

Choose a point over the specialising point: the image of the presentation is open, so there is a point of the presentation mapping to the specialising point, and by the hypothesis on the pair the fibre of the second projection over it is a quasi-compact algebraic space (proof lines 10352-10358)

Identify the relevant image: taking an affine etale cover of that fibre, the proof shows that the chosen point lies in the closure of the image of the composite to the presentation, since otherwise the openness of the map from the presentation would separate the two points (proof lines 10359-10368)

Conclude by the reach-points criterion: the criterion for points of a scheme mapping to a target now provides a point of the presentation over the specialising point which specialises to the chosen point (proof lines 10369-10372)
proof_roadmap: 先把 U 换成在其点处 étale 的仿射概型，故可设 U 仿射。令 R = U ×_X U（投影 t, s 光滑）。取 w ∈ U 映到 x′（f 开故存在）；由假设 t^{-1}(w) 是准紧代数空间。
取仿射概型 T 满 étale 映到 F′ = t^{-1}(w)。由 x′ ⇝ x 得 u 落在 T → F′ → R →^s U 的像的闭包中（否则 f(V) 给出不含 x′ 的开邻域，矛盾）；于是由「达到点」的判据存在 u′ ∈ |U| 映到 x′ 且 u′ ⇝ u。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a specialisation of points of an algebraic stack lifts to a specialisation in any smooth presentation by an algebraic space, provided the pair (stack, point) satisfies the quasi-compactness condition on the fibre of the relation above the point (author lemma at source lines 10336-10346, label lemma-specialization). The proof (source lines 10348-10373) reduces the presentation to an affine scheme, chooses a point of it over the specialising point, uses the hypothesis to see that a fibre of the relation is quasi-compact, and shows by an openness argument that the given point lies in the closure of the image of the corresponding composite, so that the reach-points criterion produces the required specialisation (proof lines 10349-10372). The closure computation with its contrapositive openness argument is the content. H2.
